data.narrative:
MATERIAL operates in the Climate & Energy sector at the Seed stage, backed by founder Gabe Elias (ex-Rivian, Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 design engineer) and CTO Dr. Christopher Reyes (Duke PhD, developer of fully 3D-printed lithium-ion batteries). The company has raised $7.1M plus $1.25M in USAF SBIR funding. The comp universe comprises 1 public peer and 8 private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Enovix, though none provided sufficient narrow-stage comparables.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using $7.1M total capital raised as a proxy base value and applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier yields an implied valuation of $18M. A Peer-Median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the Climate & Energy sector—the peer set of eight companies did not yield the minimum three datapoints required for reliable triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $15M to $20M, with a median point of $18M. This range reflects one-method triangulation with conservative downside and modest upside based on typical early-stage progression mechanics. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrowly comparable seed-stage companies in the sector, making single-method reliance a material limitation. Technology validation risk and SBIR grant trajectory represent additional valuation sensitivities not quantified here.
